fields.description: The Sanctuary is Ellington’s villa community in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. The reviewed Waterside launch comprises four-, five- and six-bedroom homes with private pools, lifts and courtyard layouts.

reviewCoverage.identity: Official Sanctuary microsite and own Waterside documents verified. Canonical nameSource ?p=40937 resolves One River Point and is not used as Sanctuary evidence.
reviewCoverage.location: Official launch establishes Mohammed Bin Rashid City; portal identifies District 11. No assumed current area alias.
reviewCoverage.residences: The Waterside first-cluster launch states 17 villas with four named families. Later Sanctuary clusters and Watercrest are not merged into this document scope.
reviewCoverage.areas: All 34 plan pages read; actual numeric panels 4,9,14,19,24,29 visually checked for Retreat styles 1/2, Hideaway style 2, Escape style 1 and Oasis styles 1/2. Printed total and plot areas remain distinct.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own villa/communal facilities from Waterside brief and plans, without assuming access rights for later clusters.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Actual brief page 33 prints original Oasis from AED 17 million. Current unit availability and price are not established.
reviewCoverage.payment: Actual own one-page sheet visually checked: 20+eight 5+40=100. Calendar examples run April 2023–August 2025 and are historical, not restarted dates.
reviewCoverage.handover: Actual brief page 8 forecasts Q4 2025; Property Finder gives January 2027. No own handover confirmation retrieved; headline null.
reviewCoverage.documents: Working primary 41-page Waterside brief, 34-page floor plans and one-page payment sheet obtained. Six plan panels plus configuration, price and payment pages visually checked.

overview: The Waterside collection brings individually planned villas into a gated lagoon-side setting.
research.locationNote: Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai; Property Finder places the community in District 11. Confirm the selected cluster and plot.
research.priceNote: The Waterside guide advertises Oasis four-bedroom villas from AED 17 million. This historical launch reference does not establish present availability or price.
research.handoverNote: The Waterside brief forecasts Q4 2025; Property Finder instead gives January 2027 for its Sanctuary listing. Different cluster scope and date revisions remain unresolved.
research.paymentNote: The original Waterside sheet uses reservation-relative instalments with historical 2023–2025 calendar examples. Obtain the selected villa’s actual outstanding schedule.
